newsitem.title: USA: Salomon commits Sinter $275 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: Salomon commits Sinter $275 mln credit.

text.p: Salomon Inc's Salomon Brothers Holding Co said on Monday it committed $275 million in senior secured loan facilities to Ohio-based Sinter Metals Inc for financing a new acquisition.

Salomon said it was the financial advisor to Sinter in the company's acquisition of Krebsoge Sinterholding GmbH and Powder Metal Holdings Inc from Maag Holding AG of Switzerland, announced earlier Monday.
The acquisition would make Sinter the largest producer of precision pressed powder metal components in the world, Salomon said.

Salomon said it expected there would be term loans with maturities of up to 8-1/2 years totalling $235 milion as well as a revolving credit of $40 million. A portion of the facilites would be in foreign currencies to finance the newly acquired European acquisitions, it said.
